title: fix(plugin-approvals)!: under a walled tenancy posture, an approval request with no organization is acted on only by a platform administrator or the system
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the change is who the approval doors admit at runtime on a stored request with no organization; no published skill teaches the administrator override on such a request

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 `group` / `isolated` 墙内姿态下,没有组织归属的审批请求只由平台管理员或系统处理;组织管理员在每个审批动作上得到与"请求不存在"相同的 `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`,请求不变。
- 为什么改:ADR-0131 D1 规定 NULL 不是归属;按维护者裁决,组织管理员的权限止于本组织,`single` 姿态不变。
- 风险与回滚:只影响墙内姿态下 ADR-0131 D9 之前存下的无组织请求;平台管理员与系统照常处理。回滚 = 还原 `approval-service.ts` 中 `isOverrideActor` 的一行判断。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`(`isOverrideActor` 中 `requestOrg == null` 一行与新增 `organizationWallStands`);`approval-tenant-positions-name-authority.test.ts` 新增的顶层 describe;changeset。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/approval-tenant-positions-name-authority.test.ts`,预期 90 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule (ADR-0131 D1: NULL is not a state and names no owner), applied where every approval door asks who may override:

- Under a walled tenancy posture (`group`, `isolated`), an approval request that carries no organization is acted on only by a platform administrator or a system context. An organization administrator is answered on approve, reject, recall, reassign, revise (send back), resubmit, remind, request info and comment exactly as for an id that names no request (`REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`, `404` at the HTTP door), and the request is unchanged.
- Under `single`, nothing changes: a tenant administrator acts on such a request.
- A request that carries an organization keeps its rule: an administrator of that organization, or a platform administrator.

`ApprovalService.isOverrideActor` is the one predicate every act door and the list door's viewer flag ask, so the rule is stated once there. The posture is read through the service's existing tenancy-posture provider and the shared spec predicate `postureEnforcesWall` (`organizationWallStands`, no second spelling). A stack with no tenancy service has no wall anywhere, so an unresolvable posture reads as unwalled, the reading `vetOrganizationClaim` takes.

No backfill, no boot-time step, no change to `backfill-platform-row-organizations.ts` or the CLI inventory. The changeset points operators at the existing, voluntary `os migrate organization-ownership` ceremony (plan first, then `--apply`).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-tenant-positions-name-authority.test.ts`: one new top-level describe in the shared harness for the tenant arm, with the tenant administrator resolved through the real `resolveUserAuthzGrants`.
  - Under `isolated` and under `group`, for each of the nine act doors: the tenant administrator is refused with the answer an id that names no request gets, and the request and its action history are unchanged; side by side, the refusal on the row and on a missing id are identical once the id is written out, and the read door answers both `null`.
  - The list door does not show the request to the tenant administrator; a system read lists it.
  - CONTROLS, each on approve, reject, recall and reassign: a platform administrator and a system context act under both walled postures; an organization's own administrator acts on that organization's request; an administrator of another organization is refused on an organization's request; under `single` the tenant administrator acts on a request with no organization.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-act-doors-read-visibility.dogfood.test.ts`: one new door-level case on a real `isolated` boot. The owner of organization A and the owner of organization B each get, on every act door, the status and body an id that names no request gets, and nothing is written; the seeded platform administrator decides the request; A's owner decides A's own request.
- One-shot ablation of the new posture check, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: 36 of 90 pins red, then restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The controls stayed green under the ablation, as they should.

## Acceptance notes

- An admitted caller whose active organization is not the request's (a platform administrator, or a tenant administrator under `single`, acting on a request with no organization) can be answered `READ_BACK_FAILED` after the write lands: the echo is read in the caller's organization scope. That is the existing, loud write-recorded answer and is unchanged here; the control pins accept it and assert the write landed.
- Not merged with `origin/main`: the 11 commits since the base touch neither `plugin-approvals`, the dogfood file, nor the posture predicate.
- The provenance in the code comment is ADR-0131 D1; the maintainer's ruling is not linked from public text.
